title: Roadworthy Rescues
description: Derek and his brother Sean head back to their family farm in North Dakota; intent on building a goin'-to-town rig for the old farmstead, they dig out a 1971 Chevrolet Chevelle sedan that's buried in cow pies and has a waterlogged engine.

title: Roadworthy Rescues
description: In need of a new riding lawn mower, Derek heads east to find himself a 1950 Ford 8N tractor; with a cracked engine block and a bees' nest for a battery, Derek will have to revisit his farming routes to make this implement operational.

title: Vegas Rat Rods
description: Steve and the Welder Up crew have to get creative when they're tasked with building an iron-worker themed rat rod that doubles as a work truck; Justin makes a big mistake; Steve tries to flip a beat-up 1967 Coronet that he finds in a junkyard.

title: Vegas Rat Rods
description: With only two weeks left to go, the Welder Up crew still has to build an engine for Tyrone's Iron Rod truck and install it and then re-cut the frame to add shocks.

title: Hot Rod Garage
description: Tony Angelo and Lucky Costa swap in a junkyard-fresh 5.3L on a low-buck drag project, the Bonemaro; they perform some critical upgrades along the way.

title: My Classic Car
description: Dennis travels to Sweden for a car and boat show, then he'll head over to Nashville to check out a couple of classic trucks.

title: Roadkill
description: The street freak 1975 AMC has had failures, but now the Hemi-powered Gremlin finally completes a road trip; Freiburger and Finnegan drive from Detroit to St. Louis and finally give the Hemi Gremmie the trip it deserves.

title: Truck U
description: Truck U puts the final touches on a Dodge D150 from Two Guys Garage. From protection under the bed, sound and heat insulation, better stance and firmer steering, this truck will finally be exactly what the owner always wanted.

title: Garage Squad
description: Restoring a Grand National takes a hard left turn; a 1987 Grand National owned the road in the 1980s, but has fallen on hard times.

title: Garage Squad
description: A 1968 Chevrolet El Camino requires new brakes, a vital engine refresh and exhaust work to get it back on the road.

title: Garage Squad
description: Time and storage take a toll on a 1969 Dodge Charger that has remained in its original owner's family since it rolled off the lot.

title: Two Guys Garage
description: Willie B and Kevin unveil an incredible wide-body C10 that could be their most ambitious project ever. The goal is to transform it into a 1,000-hp street machine, combining cutting-edge engineering, premium aftermarket parts and show-stopping style.

title: Build for Off-Road
description: Ian transforms a 2024 Ford F-250 into a better-looking, more capable tow rig. Along the way, we'll take a closer look at some common trouble spots found in modern Ford diesel trucks and explore upgrades that improve both performance and functionality.

title: Two Guys Garage
description: Willie and Kevin help the owner of a 1955 Nomad wagon complete this lifelong project and get it ready to go back on the track.

title: Hot Rod Garage
description: Tony Angelo and Lucky Costa are reunited with the Crown Hick, a 1966 F-100 sitting on an entire 2007 Crown Victoria frame, with suspension upgrades and a supercharger.

title: Truck U
description: The Chevy 2500 AT4 is back in the shop for some maintenance and additional power after adding larger 37-inch tires. We will then go to a small town to see semi-trucks throw down to see who can tow 120,000 pounds uphill the quickest.

title: Hot Rod Garage
description: Tony and Lucky stray way off the beaten path with a 1990 Plymouth Voyager five-speed, turbocharged minivan; the boys refresh the suspension, engine and accessories until this 250,000-mile van is as good as new.

title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten
description: Newbern and Cotten discover a gem which is not a typical American muscle with a turbocharged Eagle Talon; Shea Seefeldt challenges the guys on a rally course with his LS-swapped Subaru.

title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten
description: Newbern surprises Cotten with a mint 1984 G-body and an '80s-style, stock-car-inspired build to take on an actual former cup car around the circle track.

title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten
description: Cotten's Pro Street big-block 1980 Dodge Mirada's engine dies on Roadkill; things don't go as planned as the guys attempt to add a giant blower and bigger tires, and bring the car back to its 1990s-era glory.

title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten
description: When Grave Digger himself calls you out, there's only one thing to do, send it; the guys send it by transforming a stock 1972 Jeep into a Tough Truck competitor to challenge the field at Dennis Anderson's Muddy Motorsports Park in North Carolina.

title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten

description: Rough-and-tumble car gets a second act.

description: Tony Angelo and Lucky Costa try to stuff a V-8 engine into a tiny British car.

title: Motorhead Garage
description: If it goes, Dave Dobson and the Motorhead Garage crew are fans. They bring you their love for all things motorized as they modify cars, trucks, ATVs and motorcycles using aftermarket equipment, ranging from the tried-and-true to the innovative and new.

title: Garage Squad
description: The team is called in to rescue a 1969 Plymouth Road Runner; the owner has been busy helping others.

description: A '65 Comet that has been stripped of its motor soars back to life.

title: Garage Squad
description: After 30 years in storage, a Triumph Spitfire sputters back on the road.

title: Build for Off-Road
description: Ian tackles some of the design issues on his FJ45 project, making the necessary changes to get the build back on track. With a redesigned exhaust system and upgraded brakes, the FJ45 is ready to start moving forward again.

title: Build for Off-Road
description: After coming down from the top of the World, the team takes on one of Moab's trails, Hell's Revenge; with drop-offs, steep climbs and the infamous Hell's Gate, this trail puts both the rigs and drivers to the ultimate test.

title: Hot Rod Garage
description: Lucky and Tony upgrade a '66 Chevelle with a 475-hp NA LS engine, constructed with AFR heads and a rack-and-pinion conversion to make the drive even better.

title: Vegas Rat Rods
description: The crew transforms a 1958 Chevy Apache into a badass Vintage Dirt Bike Hauler; Steve jumps at the chance to bring Evel Knievel's Formula 1 Dragster back to life.

title: Vegas Rat Rods
description: With the delivery date for the ultimate Vintage Dirt Bike Hauler imminent, Steve pushes his crew to complete his vision; Welder Up's reputation for building the meanest and fastest rat rods is challenged.

title: Vegas Rat Rods
description: Steve is asked to build a scary villain rat rod in three weeks and a vintage-inspired charity bike for military veterans in two weeks; Steve worries when the villain car frame takes longer than expected and the Vet Bike won't start.

title: Vegas Rat Rods
description: Steve and the crew commit to meeting the original Superhero build time and delivering the Villain Rat Rod in three weeks; with no sign of a transmission, it doesn't look as though the crew will escape the clutches of this perilous deadline.

title: Vegas Rat Rods
description: Steve agrees to build a crazy 1970s-era gasser racecar for a U.S. Navy veteran; Steve tries to make money by restoring and flipping a Prohibition-era bootlegger Model A truck for a Las Vegas police captain.

title: Vegas Rat Rods
description: The Welder Up crew scrambles to finish the 1970s gasser, but they run into several problems while testing the car out; Merlon plans a surprise gift for Steve to replace a bike he loved as a kid but lost.

title: Vegas Rat Rods
description: When Steve is commissioned to build a spooky car, he digs up a haunted '55 Chevy and Justin and Travis battle to modify the cursed car; Steve and Merlon flip a Depression-era Plymouth.
